global_allocation_guard_requirements: Native maximum Q length is 4 and GQA group size is 6, proving all compliant tasks have at most 24 M rows
0<s2BaseSize<=512; actual S2 tile alignment must remain at most 512
KV_T and OUT_T are two-byte BF16 or FP16 types
keySinkNumber==0 so synthetic sink tiles cannot exceed the S2 bound
Other geometry retains original outputQue1 allocation and workspace recurrence

single_accumulator_lifetime_proof.axis_order: fia_kernel_nonquant_sink.h:968-987: S2 is innermost, then gS1, then BN2
single_accumulator_lifetime_proof.execution_order: fia_kernel_nonquant_sink.h:1035-1058: one monotonically ordered Vec2 task per execution step; newer Vec1 runs first but must not access independent running-O TBuf

resident_task_guard_requirements: actual actMBaseSize==24 and one Vec2 M chunk
info.tndIsS2SplitCore==false; flash-decode heads use original workspace route
First task initializes the independent accumulator; last task invalidates its identity
Eligibility must remain invariant throughout a head: once workspace writes are omitted, an unexpected mid-head fallback cannot safely read stale vec2ResGm
synchronization_requirements: Do not retain an inputQue1 tensor across tasks: next Vec1 reuses inputQue1
Do not alias outputQue1 storage as persistent accumulator: next Vec1 softmax cast reuses outputQue1
Use a dedicated TBuf touched only by Vec2 vector instructions
Preserve PIPE_V dependency barriers at initialization/copy, rescale, Add and normalization boundaries

Resident nonfinal tasks must bridge V to MTE3 explicitly before ComputeVec2 emits syncV2C2 on PIPE_MTE3 (fia_block_vec_nonquant_sink.h:1215): removing outputQue1 EnQue and workspace store also removes their V-to-MTE3 completion dependency. Cube waits syncV2C2 immediately before FixpipeCToGM overwrites mm2ResGm (fia_block_cube_nonquant_gqa_sink.h:1434-1445)
Keep existing final cast and outputQue1 EnQue/DeQue transition to protect V-to-MTE3 output
Do not let MTE3 read the persistent accumulator directly without explicit completion protection
fair_comparison: Actual per-head plan eligibility decides fast-path use; upstream and whole must load the same patched consumer and get the same eligible path

patch_review.allocation: 184 KiB remains unchanged; dedicated running-O TBuf is independent of both shared queues
patch_review.fallback_capacity: When outputQue1 is 16 KiB, ProcessVec2SingleBuf caps M chunk to 16 rows. D256 FP32 fallback intermediate and FD staging are at most 16 KiB. Current qualified heads still use exactly the original per-AIV 16/8 row chunks
patch_review.vec1_capacity: ProcessVec1SingleBuf already caps each FP32 tile at 32 KiB, so BF16 softmax/zero output fits 16 KiB even for compliant tasks that do not use residency
patch_review.crosscore_completion: Nonfinal resident store explicitly bridges V_MTE3 before the existing PIPE_MTE3 syncV2C2 publication
patch_review.cold_spill: The saved previous loop workspace offset and exact element count are published under V_MTE3, then MTE3_MTE2 and MTE3_V completion events. Legal same-shape S2 discontinuity can resume legacy recurrence from that previous-loop value
patch_review.cold_spill_limit: The spill is not a guarantee for arbitrary malformed descriptors changing actual Q/M shape within a head. Native legal head geometry and ownership remain invariant

remaining_risks: Compiler UB allocation and emitted instruction legality need an isolated build
Device correctness must verify both full-head and FD fallback paths, input/state identities and FP32 reference
Maximum-Q metadata is a native producer contract; malformed descriptors exceeding it cannot be made safe by a late task fallback after shrinking outputQue1
Running-O workspace removal may expose another pipeline stall; source byte estimates do not establish HBM traffic or speedup
This is an on-chip online-softmax adaptation, not a claim that on-chip accumulation is novel
